"""Bounded checkpoint wording/count audit; no native execution or canonical writes."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = ROOT / "reports/p1-018/finish-branch40"
rows = {}


def row(p):
    p = Path(p)
    if not p.is_absolute(): p = ROOT / p
    b = p.read_bytes()
    r = {"path": p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), "bytes": len(b), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
    rows[r["path"]] = r
    return r


def load(p):
    row(p)
    return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())


def text(p):
    row(p)
    return Path(p).read_text()


def check_refs(v):
    if isinstance(v,dict):
        if "path" in v and "sha256" in v:
            actual = row(v["path"])
            assert actual["sha256"] == v["sha256"]
            if "bytes" in v: assert actual["bytes"] == v["bytes"]
        for x in v.values(): check_refs(x)
    elif isinstance(v,list):
        for x in v: check_refs(x)


def main():
    assert not (OUT / "readback05.json").exists()
    snapshot = OUT / "inputs05"
    snapshot.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    docs = ["docs/vehicles/endurance-sedan/acceptance.json", "docs/vehicles/endurance-sedan/defects.json", "evidence/M5/P1-018.json"]
    parsed = {}
    for f in docs:
        p = ROOT / f
        data = p.read_bytes()
        saved = snapshot / f.replace("/","__")
        saved.write_bytes(data)
        row(saved)
        row(p)
        parsed[f] = json.loads(data)
    checkpoint = load(BASE / "checkpoint49.json")
    check_refs(checkpoint)
    assert parsed[docs[2]]["runtime_completion_checkpoint_v49"] == checkpoint
    before = json.loads(subprocess.run(["git", "show", "7db4e0589be61c1b4793f2666250104ebcd70074:"+docs[0]],cwd=ROOT,check=True,capture_output=True).stdout)
    current = parsed[docs[0]]
    assert [r["id"] for r in before["rows"]] == [r["id"] for r in current["rows"]]
    for old,new in zip(before["rows"],current["rows"]):
        assert all(old[k] == new[k] for k in ("id","stage","required_evidence","failure_condition"))
        assert new["human_approval_reference"] is None
    assert current["human_gates_status"] == "pending"
    assert parsed[docs[2]]["status"] == "in_progress"
    assert parsed[docs[2]]["human_approval_reference"] is None
    assert all(r["status"] == "pending" and r["approval_reference"] is None for r in parsed[docs[2]]["human_gates"])
    diff = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--", *docs],cwd=ROOT,check=True,capture_output=True).stdout
    (OUT / "docs05.diff").write_bytes(diff)
    row(OUT / "docs05.diff")
    suites = {}
    for command in checkpoint["commands"]:
        result = load(ROOT / command["result"]["path"])
        assert result["exit_status"] == 0 and result["inputs_before"] == result["inputs_after"]
        assert result["argv"] == command["command"]
        suites[command["suite"]] = {"status":0,"exact_before_after_rows":len(result["inputs_before"]),"scope":result["scope"]}
    dynamics = BASE / "regressions/dynamics/dynamics"
    matrix = text(dynamics / "matrix.log")
    records = re.findall(r"^CANNONBALL_VEHICLE_DYNAMICS_RUN_OK .+$",matrix,re.M)
    assert len(records) == 79
    identities = [json.loads(s) for s in re.findall(r"^CANNONBALL_VEHICLE_DYNAMICS_IDENTITY (.+)$",matrix,re.M)]
    assert len(identities) == 1 and identities[0]["asset_id"] == "hero-gt" and not identities[0]["uses_graybox"]
    assert re.search(r"CANNONBALL_VEHICLE_DYNAMICS_SUITE_OK runs=79 profiles=3 speed_bands=3 fixtures=12 physics_hz=120",matrix)
    fps = {}
    for n in (30,60,144):
        log = text(dynamics / f"fps-{n}.log")
        assert len(re.findall(r"^CANNONBALL_VEHICLE_DYNAMICS_RUN_OK ",log,re.M)) == 1
        marker = re.search(r"CANNONBALL_VEHICLE_DYNAMICS_SUITE_OK runs=1 .*result_hash=([a-f0-9]{64})",log)
        assert marker and "CANNONBALL_SHUTDOWN_OK" in log
        ident = json.loads(re.search(r"^CANNONBALL_VEHICLE_DYNAMICS_IDENTITY (.+)$",log,re.M)[1])
        assert ident["asset_id"] == "hero-gt" and not ident["uses_graybox"]
        fps[n] = marker[1]
    assert len(set(fps.values())) == 1
    core = text(dynamics / "core-tests.log")
    assert re.search(r"Failed:\s+0, Passed:\s+29, Skipped:\s+0, Total:\s+29", core)
    vehicles = BASE / "regressions/vehicles/vehicles"
    stage_counts = {}
    for name,count in (("endurance-sedan",17),("hero-gt",16),("graybox",16)):
        directory = vehicles / name
        summary = load(directory / "summary.json")
        gate = load(directory / "gate.json")
        process = load(directory / "process.json")
        log = text(directory / "engine.log")
        assert summary["status"] == gate["status"] == process["status"] == "passed"
        assert gate["failures"] == [] and process["exit_code"] == 0 and not process["timed_out"]
        native = re.findall(r"CANNONBALL_ENDURANCE_SEDAN_STAGE_OK vehicle="+name+r" stage=(\S+) frames=",log)
        assert len(native) == len(set(native)) == count
        assert native == summary["expected_stages"] == [r["stage"] for r in summary["completed_stages"]]
        assert all(r["status"] == "passed" for r in summary["completed_stages"])
        assert "CANNONBALL_SHUTDOWN_OK" in log
        for f,h in gate["outputs"].items(): assert row(directory / f)["sha256"] == h
        stage_counts[name] = native
    directory = vehicles / "endurance-sedan/presentation"
    presentation = load(directory / "presentation-summary.json")
    gate = load(directory / "gate.json")
    process = load(directory / "process.json")
    log = text(directory / "engine.log")
    native = re.findall(r"CANNONBALL_SEDAN_PRESENTATION_STAGE_OK stage=(\S+) posed=true",log)
    assert len(native) == len(set(native)) == 52
    assert native == presentation["expected_stages"] == [r["stage"] for r in presentation["completed_stages"]]
    assert presentation["status"] == gate["status"] == process["status"] == "passed"
    assert not presentation["rendered"] and process["exit_code"] == 0
    assert "CANNONBALL_SEDAN_PRESENTATION_OK stages=52 posed=true rendered=false" in log
    assert "CANNONBALL_SHUTDOWN_OK" in log
    for f,h in gate["outputs"].items(): assert row(directory / f)["sha256"] == h
    front = load(BASE / "regressions/frontdoor/m0/summary.json")
    assert front["status"] == "passed" and len(front["steps"]) == 13
    assert all(s["status"] == "passed" and s["exit_code"] == 0 for s in front["steps"])
    for step in front["steps"]: row(BASE / "regressions/frontdoor/m0" / step["log"])
    output = {
        "task_id":"P1-018", "utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "status":"quantitative-claims-confirmed-with-three-wording-recommendations",
        "scope":"Checkpoint49 and current canonical document diff only; no native/build/GPU/geometry execution or edits",
        "checkpoint":row(BASE / "checkpoint49.json"),"suites":suites,
        "counts":{"pure_dynamics":29,"explicit_Hero_matrix":79,"fps_cases":{str(n):1 for n in fps},"driving":{k:len(v) for k,v in stage_counts.items()},"headless_presentation":52,"frontdoor":13},
        "native_Hero_identity":identities[0], "fps_formatted_summary_hashes":fps,
        "driving_stage_names":stage_counts,"headless_presentation_stage_names":native,
        "acceptance_contract_rows_unchanged":len(current["rows"]),
        "final_source_export_performance_and_human_gates_open":True,
        "recommendations":[
            {"id":"CP49-QA01","location":"checkpoint49.failures_and_retries.neutral_static","correction":"14,400-frame cap; failed observation at frame14,401, not a14,401-frame cap."},
            {"id":"CP49-QA02","location":"acceptance.S01.verified_scope","correction":"Full scenario passes while preserving51 assertion sites and52 action/request/capture sites. Conditional sites such as explicit window size were not all executed in the default-size run."},
            {"id":"CP49-QA03","location":"evidence top-level input_artifacts/output_artifacts/metrics/completed_machine_evidence","correction":"Explicitly identify these unchanged values as the historical production34 snapshot (including specification17 and old157-test frontdoor), with49 measurements separately authoritative."}
        ],
        "parent_response":"Accepted; initial49 retained unchanged; lead will add a new corrected supplement and label canonical historical fields before push.",
        "limits":["FPS comparison is of formatted summary hashes, not full trace identity or renderer performance.","17/16/16 driving and52 headless posed stages are not final source/visual/mirror/performance approval.","No input rows or native mathematics were rerun; complete before/after equality and actual terminal outputs were consumed."],
        "inputs":sorted(rows.values(),key=lambda r:r["path"]),"human_approval_reference":None,
    }
    (OUT / "readback05.json").write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2)+"\n")
    print(json.dumps({"status":"passed","output":row(OUT/"readback05.json"),"bound_files":len(rows)}))


if __name__ == "__main__": main()
